text: Weekly China recap: - Offshore down big this week MXCN -4.6% while onshore CSI300 -1.6%, the 11th straight week of closing down (-12.6% total so far), which is the 1st time this has happened since the index began tracking in Aug 2005. - DeepSeek caps off busy week of model drops and releases with DeepInfer, basically open sourcing their inference economics: each GPU earns $38/hour, implying margins of 85%+ (this excl. model training costs, etc.) - PBoC signaled a potential shift in the main policy rate to the overnight reverse repo rate, alongside broader interest rate benchmark reforms https://www.yicai.com/brief/103399074.html - Q3 GDP accelerated to +4.5% yoy, slightly beating expectations & Sep IP/Retail Sales growth improved to +5.5%/+1.1% yoy - 3Q'26 Earnings season begins: 16% reported, +13% earnings growth yoy
China 3Q'26 Earnings Season kicked off this week. Results so far - All China: 16% reported, +13% earnings growth yoy - A-shares: 18% reported, +17% yoy - Offshore: 7% reported, -5% yoy
